name: line-mcp-app
description: LINE 次要裝置同步 + 本機 MCP（Android App 核心）

scripts.android:debug: npm run bundle:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:review: npm run native:android && npm run bundle:android:release && cd android && ./gradlew assembleReview
scripts.android:release: npm run bundle:android:release && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && for f in app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk; do bash ../scripts/purge-mock-check.sh $f; done
